question: Can one model call extract correct weight-management encounters with citable spans, excluding what REQ-9 excludes? (D2, D10)
scoring: D17: an event matches on ISO date; spans anchored by quote.

spans.quote:
01/09/2025 - Initial program visit. Height 165 cm, weight 112.4 kg, BMI 41.3.
Reviewed a 1500 kcal reduced-calorie meal plan in detail and provided a portion
guide. Counseled on walking 20 minutes daily, three days per week.

02/06/2025 - Program visit 2. Weight 110.1 kg, BMI 40.4. Dietary recall
reviewed; patient adherent to the meal plan. Activity advanced to four days per
week of walking.

03/06/2025 - Program visit 3. Weight 108.8 kg, BMI 39.9. Discussed protein
intake and evening snacking. Patient reports 25 minutes of stationary cycling,
four days per week.

1400 kcal. Continues cycling four days weekly; added light resistance bands.

05/08/2025 - Program visit 5. Weight 105.9 kg, BMI 38.9. Reviewed restaurant
ordering strategies. Exercise tolerance improved, now 30 minutes five days per
week.

06/05/2025 - Program visit 6. Weight 104.6 kg, BMI 38.4. Dietary adherence
remains good. Activity sustained at 30 minutes, five days per week. Patient has
completed six consecutive months of supervised participation.

02/11/2025 - Program visit. Weight 118.9 kg, BMI 43.7 recorded. Reviewed
calorie-controlled meal plan, 1600 kcal. Activity goal set at 15 minutes of
walking daily.

03/13/2025 - Program visit. Weight 117.2 kg, BMI 43.1. Dietary counseling on
carbohydrate distribution across meals. Walking increased to 25 minutes daily.

04/10/2025 - Program visit. Weight 116.4 kg, BMI 42.8. Reviewed food diary in
detail. Reports walking 25 minutes, five days per week.

06/12/2025 - Program visit. Weight 117.8 kg, BMI 43.3. Discussed the lapse in
attendance. Meal plan reviewed and restarted at 1600 kcal. Activity goal reset
to 20 minutes daily.

07/10/2025 - Program visit. Weight 116.9 kg, BMI 43.0. Dietary adherence
improving. Walking 20 minutes, four days per week.
